text:
maria: kicking off a coordinated preflight for the API + runtime + console + router bundle. change window 02:00-03:00 UTC. this is a small schema tweak on console and a batching kernel on runtime. router requires a header-split swap. tagging @alex @ben for router coordination. release notes: https://releases.redwood.ai/2026-03/coord-bundle

alex: acked. i've run local smoke for console schema change 10x smaller payloads. runtime:v2.3 includes the batching kernel built and integration-tested. router header-split requires a staged traffic-shift.

ben: router plan: header-split-v1 rollout via header-flag. staged traffic shift: 10% (5m) -> 50% (10m) -> 100% (10m). will watch header mismatch logs and routing errors.

maria: deploy-bot, schedule canary start at 02:05 UTC and apply pins for api/runtime/console to v2.3. router to be traffic shifted to header-split-v1. keeper for final GO: @maria.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary at 02:05 UTC for thread 1777777888. will post events and pin confirmations.

sam: rollback criteria check: error rate > 0.5% sustained 3m OR p95 latency > 2x baseline sustained 3m. also add: KV cache miss rate > 20% sustained 3m or runtime OOM spikes.

alex: agreed. ensure metric names in runbook match alerts: infra.api.errors.rate, runtime.latency.p95, runtime.kv.miss.rate, runtime.oom.count. add automatic rollback to pinned variants if triggered.

ben: pinned fallback variants noted: api:v2.2, runtime:q8-v2.2, console:v2.2. router rollback will flip header flag back to header-old. pin file saved at /ops/pins/1777777888-pins.json. snippet to pin router variant in orch:
```bash
curl -X POST https://orch.internal/pin -d '{"service":"router","variant":"header-split-v1"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ORCH'
```

maria: checklist (reply with :thumbsup: when you own a step):
- upload preflight logs
- schedule canary
- prepare pin configs
- add rollback runbook to release notes
- enable post-canary perf hooks

alex: preflight logs uploaded 705

ben: pin configs prepared and stored. router flagging script ready.

sam: runbook added into release notes under Troubleshooting -> Rollback with exact alert names and runbook IDs.

deploy-bot: canary started at 02:05 UTC 10% traffic to header-split-v1. monitoring: infra/errors, runtime/latency, runtime/kv-miss, runtime/oom.

maria: dashboards green. watching p95 and kv-miss closely.

deploy-bot: advanced to 50% at 02:15 UTC after no alert triggers.

alex: saw a transient p95 spike at 02:18 but recovered under threshold. not initiating rollback.

ben: router traces look clean, no header mismatch logs. shifting to 100% now.

deploy-bot: canary reached 100% at 02:25 UTC. applied pins: api:v2.3, runtime:v2.3, console:v2.3, router:header-split-v1.

sam: post-canary checks at +5m and +10m look nominal: p50/p95 stable, kv-miss within expected band.

maria: merge small console note into release notes and update released-by. @alex can you merge?

alex: merged PR for release notes. closing change window at 02:58 UTC. good run team :tada:

ben: i'll monitor logs for next 12h and escalate if anything odd shows up.

maria: thanks everyone. runbook handed to oncall. if any regression, follow rollback flow: immediate traffic flip for router, pin older variants for API/runtime/console, and notify postmortem channel.
